description: A Comprehensive Toolkit for High-Quality PDF Content Extraction

summary.one_liner: PDF-Extract-Kit is an open-source modular toolkit of pretrained models for extracting content from complex PDFs, covering layout detection, formula detection and recognition, OCR, and table recognition.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides a set of document-parsing models wired into runnable scripts, each driven by a YAML config file. Supported tasks are layout detection (images, tables, text, titles, formulas), formula detection (inline and block), formula recognition into LaTeX, OCR using PaddleOCR, and table recognition producing LaTeX, HTML, or Markdown. Layout detection defaults to DocLayout-YOLO, with YOLO-v10 and LayoutLMv3 as alternatives. Results are written to per-task folders under outputs/. The README states the project is a model toolbox and does not rebuild content into new documents such as PDF-to-Markdown; that conversion is left to the separate MinerU project. Reading-order detection is listed as coming soon, and chemical equation tasks are on the to-do list.
use_cases: detect layout regions such as text, tables, and figures in PDFs
recognize math formulas in document images as LaTeX
convert table images into LaTeX, HTML, or Markdown
run OCR on PDF pages or scanned images
build document QA or translation apps on top of parsed content
compare layout and formula models on benchmark results
how_to_run: Download model weights per the Model Weights Download Tutorial
notable: Modular design: swap models by editing YAML configs with minimal code
Fine-tuned layout and formula detection models trained on diverse document annotations
Table recognition outputs LaTeX, HTML, or Markdown via StructTable-InternVL2-1B
Model weights are hosted on Hugging Face and ModelScope
Positioned as the model layer beneath the MinerU document-conversion tool
caveats: Does not convert PDFs into new documents such as Markdown; the README points to MinerU for that
Model weights must be downloaded separately before running
DocLayout-YOLO installation may fail and requires a specific pip install command if so
Reading order model is not yet available; evaluation metrics are marked Coming Soon
Licensed AGPL-3.0 because it bundles YOLO and PyMuPDF code, which may limit commercial reuse
